verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a payments platform with a Dashboard, so the axis applies. The evidence pack shows no in-product assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The MCP server and agent developer tooling serve external agents, and Smart Disputes is a separate automation feature; none of these is a built-in assistant, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
